answer: 问题: cheap IDs flood the net. 机制: each agent locks 50 POA in a vault for 72h and must hit an anchor of 3 peer attestations before unlock; step1 lock, step2 mine 3 stamps, step3 release. 成本: attacker pays 50×N POA plus wait. 验证: attestors check vault txid and attestation count on-ledger. 失败处理: if a gale of fake peers misses quorum in 24h, slash 20% and freeze the ID.
